questions.q: What is Service Portal, as distinct from the Classic UI / UI16 workspace covered earlier in this course?
options: A reporting dashboard only administrators can view
A mobile app distinct from any web interface
A branded, end-user-facing self-service website that callers use without touching an agent workspace
A new name for the Classic UI agent workspace
questions.explain: Classic UI / UI16 is where agents work tickets; Service Portal is the separate, self-service surface callers use.

questions.q: What does a Theme record control in Service Portal, and why is it kept separate from individual Pages?
options: Portal-wide branding and CSS applied to every page at once, so a single change updates the look everywhere without editing each page
Only the text content of the portal's homepage
The database schema used by sc_req_item
Which agents are assigned to which assignment groups
questions.explain: Separating Theme from Page is exactly what lets one branding change propagate across the whole portal.

questions.q:
Looking at this layer diagram, which record sits directly above Pages and holds the widgets that render on each one?

```text
Portal   (the site, e.g. /sp)
  |
  +-- Theme   (branding + CSS, applies to every page)
  |
  +-- Pages   (Homepage, Catalog, KB, Ticket Status...)
        |
        +-- Widgets
```
options: Theme — widgets are configured inside the Theme record
Portal — widgets are configured directly on the Portal record
Pages — widgets are placed directly on individual Pages, not on the Portal or Theme records
Widgets sit above Pages in this hierarchy, not below them
questions.explain: The diagram places Widgets as children of Pages — each Page holds the widgets that render its content.

questions.q: How does UI Builder / Next Experience relate to Service Portal, per this lesson?
options: UI Builder is only used to configure the agent's Classic UI workspace
It is ServiceNow's newer, component-based alternative for building end-user experiences, while Service Portal remains real and widely used in production
UI Builder is simply another name for Service Portal
UI Builder replaced Service Portal entirely and Service Portal no longer exists in any instance
questions.explain: UI Builder is ServiceNow's current direction for new builds, but Service Portal is still common and worth learning for production instances.
